inputs.value: ASSET: damp limestone block wall with a little moss.
ART STYLE: detailed 16-bit pixel art. Crisp square pixels, dark outlines, soft cel shading with light dithering, slightly chunky proportions. No blur, no smooth gradients.
WORLD: dark fantasy. Crypts, stone ruins, candlelight, worn iron and old bone. Use only these colours and close tints of them: #2b1e3d, #4a3168, #7b4fa8, #c09bd8, #f2e3c6.

RULES: a seamless tileable wall texture viewed perfectly front-on, orthographic elevation, flat, no perspective, no floor or ceiling visible. Flat even colour: no gradients, no lighting, identical brightness in every corner and along every edge. Fills the frame edge to edge and repeats left to right. No objects, no shadows, no vignette, no border, no text.

_meta.title: FIXED rules for wall (do not change)
